_meta.description: Upsert-by-agent_id catalog of every LLM agent AutoSOC knows about (canonical soc-* agents + autonomously created auto-* agents). This is NOT an event log — event-like writes (invocations, decisions, trust updates) belong in .soc-evolution-log, .soc-audit-trail, or .soc-trust-scores respectively. dynamic:false keeps rogue fields out.
